challenge:
The Vietnam market has seen negative feedback/backlash from users. Marketing efforts were too focused on driving sales, while failing to provide content marketing lines that educate or assist users with gameplay recognition & adoption (The core value of the game) with each pack update 

Constant renewal of the gameplay is what keeps players engaged, so every patch update needed a campaign that brought churn users back, taught new items and kept community sentiment positive.
actions:
Act as the bridge between product & marketing. Analyzed gameplay-related data (item adoption, funnel onboarding, mastery/ranking progression...) to find room for improvements

Ran and generated 8+ gameplay marketing lines for each DAU, revenue and patch-update campaigns for Vietnam team, setting goals aligned with product metrics, and reorganized team workflow and content strategy.
results: Recovery +21%, core feature adoption +54%, earned viewership +500% (+280M)
Created the “Mất Ngủ Cùng FreeFire” series: 10M+ views in 2 months, remains an always-on content series after 3 years until now, demonstrating its sustained audience value and long-term impact.
>1B views on the 2 TikTok UGC hashtags

Started a strategic idea called “Studio Collab” between FF and Content Creators with the purpose of utilizing KOL brands on publisher official channels to test their effectiveness compared to casual formal way, also simultaneously reduced the workload and increased the productivity of the in-house team.
DAU increase by 75%, revival +2.5% (after a losing streak), Recovery increase by 21% after a patch update
